fusions.name: Set of Three
fusions.desc: Throws a javelin at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ten Thousandth Repetition
fusions.desc: A thrust at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away that deals 30 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Drilled Advance
fusions.desc: Steps you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your piercing damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaps Known by Heart
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
